title: Average Selling Price
sourceNote: AI-authored requirements draft local-reference/leetcode/manual/1251.txt; no recovered raw statement exists in the archive (index status missing-statement).
summary: For each product, compute the weighted average price: sum(price times units) divided by sum(units), where each sale is matched to the price row whose inclusive date range contains the purchase date. Round to two decimals.
inputFormat: Prices(product_id, start_date, end_date, price) with non-overlapping ranges per product; UnitsSold(product_id, purchase_date, units).
tieRules: No tie rule; ordering not stated.
edgeRules: Products with no sales: the draft says average_price is zero under a remembered contract, which is unconfirmed. Rounding method for half values is not stated.

examples.note: Product 1 price 10 from 2019-01-01 to 2019-01-31; sales 2019-01-05 units 2 and 2019-01-10 units 3: (10*2 + 10*3)/5 = 10.00. [authored-reference]
